reasons.business: Everything leads to one action, a WhatsApp date check: the hero button and the nav 'Cek tanggal' (desktop-fold), the button below pricing (desktop-page-03), the closing block (desktop-page-11) and a sticky bottom bar on every mobile screen (sheet-mobile). The only other options are 'Lihat harga' and 'Cek kami dulu', both shown as text links, so nothing competes with the button. The price sits next to the action: 'Koordinasi hari H mulai Rp 9,5 juta' is directly under the hero button on desktop and mobile (desktop-fold, mobile-fold). The pricing section answers 'where does my money go' better than most WO pages. It shows three fee-only tiers, a 30/40/30 schedule with the final payment at H+1, and the money flow 'Kalian → vendor / Kalian → Jalinan' (desktop-page-02, -03). The trust section offers things a couple can check themselves (office address and hours, the original NIB, vendor phone numbers, the last three couples' numbers, a sample contract), which fits a fraud-wary couple (sheet-desktop page-03/04). It keeps the score from 9: there is no proof the team is any good (digest: 'proof words: none', no photos of real weddings, no count of weddings or years), the price depends on guest count without saying so, and the cancellation terms are vague.

problems: The offer contradicts itself. The pricing cards fix the crew per package ('6 kru' Hari H, '8 kru' Pendampingan, '10 kru' Penuh; desktop-page-02), but the day-of section says crew follows guest count ('6 orang untuk sampai 300 tamu, 8 untuk 600, 10 untuk 1.000'). The page also promises 'Biaya tambahan: tidak ada', and the hero says 'mulai' while the cards do not. A couple with 600 guests cannot tell what they will pay. Smallest fix: add one line under the cards, e.g. 'Harga untuk sampai 300 tamu; 301–600 tamu +Rp X jt', and use the 'mulai' wording in the cards too, or remove crew counts from the cards.

The page shows the business is real but not that it is good. It has no testimonial, no count of weddings run, no years in business and no photo of a real event; only an offer to call three couples. Parents who decide with the couple need to see proof on the page before they message. Smallest fix: add one row to 'Cek kami dulu' with a hard number ('120 pernikahan sejak 2019') and a short quote from one of the three couples, with first names and the venue.

The cancellation answer ('tahap yang sudah dibayar menutup pekerjaan yang sudah dikerjakan', desktop-page-03 and the FAQ) does not say whether the 30% deposit comes back. 'What if we cancel' is the customer's last question. Smallest fix: state it in money terms, e.g. 'Batal sebelum H-30: 30% pertama tidak kembali, tahap 2 dan 3 tidak ditagih. Batal setelah H-30: 70% tidak kembali.' Minor: the pricing button (24%) asks for contact before the trust section (27%). Moving that button below the trust section, or adding one trust line beside it, would put the evidence first.
keep: The single WhatsApp date-check action, the mobile sticky bar and the button wording 'Cek tanggal kosong'. It is a low-commitment ask that fits couples 6-12 months out.
The starting price stated next to the hero button.
The fee-only pricing, the 'Kalian → vendor / Kalian → Jalinan' money flow, and the 30/40/30 schedule with the final payment at H+1. These are the page's strongest answer to the fraud fear.
The 'Cek kami dulu' list of things a couple can verify themselves, and its hero link.
The closing block that says what happens after they message (answer within one working day, a free 45-minute consultation, contract before deciding).
veto: none. Nothing reaches the veto bar. The 'Kenapa begini' story (a couple paid in full, then the venue had only received the deposit at H-10) is told as fact without a source. It is industry context, not a claim about Jalinan, and the brief confirms such cases exist, so add a source or the word 'kasus' with the month. 'Biaya tambahan: tidak ada' becomes a promise the business cannot keep if crew size, and so cost, follows guest count. Fix problem 1 and that risk goes away.
